text:
zoe-sales: Quick heads up — Nimbus Health sent procurement requirements this morning. They need a PO + countersigned MSA before POC kickoff. Also: split billing (PO for pilot, subscription after), net-45, procurement insists on customer-controlled KMS/HSM, and they explicitly said no DocuSign — they want a signed PDF (scanned or programmatically signed). Asking for SOC2 Type II report and a DPA with subprocessor disclosure. Can legal/finance/security advise? cc @leo-se @mike-legal @anya-fin @tara-security

leo-se: Thanks Zoe. A few clarification q's before we propose route: which model/instance are they buying for the pilot? Dedicated or hosted? Start date? We should prepare a POC order form + addendum so pricing/billing is explicit.

zoe-sales: Dedicated pool (Dedicated-Small, 4x A100 equivalent) for 30-day pilot, target start Mon 2026-04-06. Estimated pilot cost ~ $18k. Procurement contact: ap@nimbus.com. They said PO number will be issued to match pilot invoice.

leo-se: Drafting suggested order form snippet now — can we route this as the root PO + separate pilot addendum? If yes, finance can accept two invoices. Draft:```
Order Form (excerpt)
Customer: Nimbus Health
Product: Redwood Dedicated - Dedicated-Small
Term: 30 days (Pilot)
Billing: Invoice to ap@nimbus.com, net 45
PO: Required prior to start; reference PO# on invoice
Notes: Pilot invoiced separately from subscription/renewal
```

anya-fin: Net-45 is okay but need procurement to confirm credit/PO limits. For pilots below our finance approval threshold ($50k) we can accept standard PO + invoice path without exec finance sign-off. Split invoicing is fine — we require separate PO numbers for pilot vs ongoing subscription. On DocuSign: policy is we prefer e-sign (DocuSign) but if they disallow it we can provide an executed PDF (we sign and scan) — needs written approval from procurement (ap@nimbus.com) to accept scanned signature.

mike-legal: Thanks — main legal points to track: DPA subprocessor disclosure, data residency if any PHI, indemnity/liability cap language, and SLA commitments. For pilots we typically offer a POC Addendum that: (a) limits liability for the pilot period to a lower temporary cap, (b) clarifies that customer data during pilot is covered by DPA but we exclude certain subprocessors until onboarding completes, and (c) accepts scanned exec signature if procurement provides email confirmation. Will need security team to confirm KMS requirement details (BYOK vs Redwood-managed).

tara-security: KMS question: do they require keys completely in their control (BYOK with customer KMS and HSM) or is a Redwood-managed KMS with HSM and audited key custody acceptable? If they want BYOK we need AWS/GCP KMS integration details and a timeline for key provisioning. Also request: SOC2 Type II and, if PHI, a BAA. Ask Nimbus for the SOC2 report and any encryption requirements doc.

zoe-sales: I'll ask procurement for: (1) explicit confirmation they accept scanned exec-signed PDF if we provide it, (2) whether BYOK is required or if Redwood-managed KMS is OK, (3) the PO issuance timeline and billing contact CC.

leo-se: For routing: propose we do a two-item package in our system: (1) Pilot Order Form + POC Addendum (pilot terms, reduced cap, separate invoice) and (2) Master Order / Subscription for post-pilot (not executed until pilot complete). Legal can stamp the POC Addendum and Finance will invoice after PO. If Nimbus insists on no e-sign, we can produce a signed PDF from our exec and email it to procurement — request that Mike/Legal prepare a short cover email template.

mike-legal: I'll create a POC Addendum template and a one-paragraph cover email that confirms acceptance of scanned signature for this POC only (subject to procurement confirmation). Will also surface DPA redline areas; Tara please flag if BYOK requires a change in the DPA key custody clause. Expect a draft by EOD today.

anya-fin: Once POC Addendum draft is in, send to ap@nimbus.com with a billing instructions form. Finance will generate pilot invoice once PO arrives. If they insist on two distinct POs, specify separate PO numbers (pilot PO + subscription PO placeholder).

tara-security: If they require BYOK/HSM, we'll need an integration plan (timeline 3-5 business days to onboard key material) — call this out in the POC timeline. Also ask for SOC2 report via secure share link (we'll provide ours after they provide theirs).

zoe-sales: Awesome — I'll ping procurement now and get the confirmation on scanned-signed PDF + BYOK. Will update thread with their reply. Thanks all :+1:

mike-legal: Quick note — if procurement is firm on "no e-sign" for legal/compliance reasons, escalate to my manager for exec signature approval path. Prefer not to delay pilot start >1 week.

leo-se: Filing action items: 1) Mike: draft POC Addendum & cover email 2) Tara: confirm BYOK footprint/impact for DPA 3) Anya: prepare billing instructions template 4) Zoe: confirm procurement answers + forward PO when received.

anya-fin: Will standby for PO and billing form.

zoe-sales: Update (from ap@nimbus.com): procurement confirms they will accept a scanned signed PDF from an exec for the POC only, BYOK preferred but Redwood-managed KMS acceptable if HSM-backed and audit logs provided. They will issue PO tomorrow morning. Leaving note here when PO arrives.

leo-se: Great — proceed with POC Addendum flow. :rocket:
